name: screenshot_url
description:
Take a screenshot of any webpage using Crawl4AI and optionally analyze it with vision AI.

Use this when:
- You need to SEE what a webpage looks like (debug crawling issues)
- Extract info from visual content (charts, graphs, infographics, images)
- Capture page state for documentation or evidence
- Regular crawl fails but you need to know what's on the page
- User wants to see/analyze a webpage visually

Returns screenshot path (and optional AI analysis of what's visible).

url.description: URL of the webpage to screenshot

analyze.description: If true, analyze the screenshot with vision AI and describe what's visible

question.description: Specific question to ask about the screenshot (only used if analyze=true)
question.default: Describe what you see on this webpage

wait.description: Seconds to wait before taking screenshot (for JS to load)

save_path.description: Optional: specific path to save screenshot (default: temp directory)

availability.setup_hint: Set CRAWL4AI_URL in the active mode env file. CRAWL4AI_USER, CRAWL4AI_PASS, and CRAWL4AI_API_KEY are optional.
